parsed.rationale: The cluster surfaces two structurally identical interface/type-alias pairs: `Clock` + `SystemClock` in package `Caching` (Shared/Caching/Sources/Caching/Clock.swift) and `QualityClock` + `SystemQualityClock` in package `Wallpaper` (Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/Throttling/AdaptiveQualityController.swift). Both pairs share a `shared_field_count` of 1 and carry no context flags (not test, codegen, mock, or sample-app), indicating production duplication. Because `Caching` already owns the canonical `Clock` protocol and its `SystemClock` concrete alias, `Wallpaper` should depend on `Caching` (or a thin shared utilities package) and replace `QualityClock`/`SystemQualityClock` with typealiases or direct references to `Clock`/`SystemClock`, eliminating the redundant definitions in AdaptiveQualityController.swift.
